en.title: Tomb Raider: Catalyst Delayed to 2028, Amazon Games Confirms
en.summary: Crystal Dynamics' next-generation Tomb Raider title, Catalyst, has been officially pushed back to 2028. This delay follows an earlier postponement for its companion game, Legacy of Atlantis.
en.body:
The highly anticipated next-generation **Tomb Raider: Catalyst** has officially been delayed, with Amazon Games confirming a 2028 release window for the title. This news comes from **Jeffrey Gattis**, Amazon's video game boss, who shared the updated timeline with The Game Business. The delay means fans will have to wait longer to see Lara Croft's next big adventure unfold on Unreal Engine 5.

This new schedule places **Catalyst** after another upcoming **Tomb Raider** installment, **Tomb Raider: Legacy of Atlantis**. Gattis revealed that **Legacy of Atlantis** is slated for release on February 12, 2027. "Atlantis comes February 12 of next year, and then we'll follow on in 2028 with the next one," Gattis stated. While a firm launch date for **Catalyst** remains elusive, the confirmation of its 2028 arrival provides some clarity for eager players. Both games were initially announced together in December of last year, with **Catalyst** initially targeting a 2027 release for PC, PlayStation 5, and Xbox Series X/S. The official description for **Catalyst** hints at a story set in Northern India, following a mythical cataclysm and Lara's race against notorious treasure hunters to uncover ancient secrets.

## A New Era for Lara Croft

The delay of **Tomb Raider: Catalyst**, the next-gen title developed by **Crystal Dynamics**, is a significant development for the franchise. This game represents a fresh start for Lara Croft, with **Alix Wilton Regan** taking over the iconic role from **Camilla Luddington**, who voiced Lara throughout the acclaimed Survivor Trilogy. The move to Unreal Engine 5 promises a visually stunning and technically advanced experience, a prospect that has long excited the fanbase. Despite recent reports of redundancies at **Crystal Dynamics**, Amazon Games has reiterated its commitment to the **Tomb Raider** franchise, suggesting that **Catalyst** is a priority project.

## Fan Anticipation and Franchise Future

For dedicated **Tomb Raider** fans, the confirmation of the 2028 release for **Catalyst** brings a mix of emotions. While the extended wait is undoubtedly disappointing, the knowledge that the game is being given the time it needs to reach its full potential is a significant consolation. The franchise has a rich history, and fans are keen to see how **Crystal Dynamics** and **Amazon Games** will evolve Lara's journey, especially with a new voice actress and the power of a modern engine at their disposal. The success of **Legacy of Atlantis** next year will undoubtedly set the stage and build anticipation for **Catalyst**.

## What's Next

Fans can look forward to **Tomb Raider: Legacy of Atlantis** launching on February 12, 2027. Following that, **Tomb Raider: Catalyst** is now slated for a 2028 release. Further details regarding specific platforms and gameplay for **Catalyst** will likely be revealed closer to its launch window.

content_raw: Tomb Raider: Catalyst is indeed delayed to 2028, as many had suspected. Confirmation comes from Amazon’s video game boss, Jeffrey Gattis, who told The Game Business that Catalyst is now due out in 2028, with Tomb Raider: Legacy of Atlantis due out February 12, 2027. “Atlantis comes February 12 of next year, and then we'll follow on in 2028 with the next one,” Gattis said. No firmer launch window was offered. Both games were announced at the same time , in December last year. Catalyst is the next-gen, Unreal Engine 5-built Tomb Raider that developer Crystal Dynamics announced years ago now. In December, it was set for PC, PlayStation 5, and Xbox Series X and S in 2027, published by Amazon Game Studios. Here's the official blurb: Tomb Raider: Catalyst marks a bold direction for the series as Lara Croft embarks on a new adventure across Northern India. Tomb Raider: Catalyst is set in the wake of a mythical cataclysm that has unleashed ancient secrets and awakened the mysterious forces that guard them. When the most notorious treasure hunters from around the world descend on the region, Lara races to uncover the truth buried beneath the fractured landscape and stop those who would use its power for their own gain. As the ancient world collides with the present, Lara must decide who to trust among rivals and allies to prevent a catastrophe and protect a secret that could reshape the future. In June, Tomb Raider: Legacy of Atlantis was delayed from this year to February 12, 2027 release date. Alix Wilton Regan plays Lara Croft in both games, replacing Camilla Luddington, who portrayed Lara Croft in the Survivor Trilogy. In March, Crystal Dynamics suffered its fourth redundancy round in 12 months , although the Embracer-owned studio insisted it remained “fully committed to the future development" of the Lara Croft franchise. The upcoming Tomb Raider games are published by Amazon, which is also working on a Tomb Raider TV show for Prime Video starring Game of Thrones’ Sophie Turner. Wesley is Director, News at IGN.
